notes: ἡ γνῶσις gives the supplied demonstrative that to the article under rule 60 rather than leaving it unrepresented, no other source token competing for the determiner slot.

The anarthrous εἰδωλόθυτον here keeps thing as a generic completion inside the adjective's own unit under rule 17, while the arthrous εἰδωλοθύτων of 8:1, 8:4 and 8:10 gives things to the article under rule 102. The difference is in the Greek and not in the ASV's phrasing, so rule 24 is not offended.
The verbless opening clause has a prepositional predicate, so ἐν carries the supplied there is discontinuously across the negative (rules 53, 15); the subject ἡ γνῶσις keeps only its own words.
The italicized of after as is kept as a rule 7 helper on ὡς; attaching it to the following noun remains defensible and the unit note records it.
v006 is selected on r00-base and v007 underdetermined on r00-base, both of which the English permits; no textual decision is taken here (rule 12).
